run_election_ranked_pairs: run the ranked pairs voting method on a preference profile and return the ranked outcome
create_ranked_pairs_outcome: create a RankedPairsRankOutcome with rankings, scores, and a directed graph of pairwise victories
check_cycle_ranked_pairs: check if adding a directed edge to the pairwise graph would create a cycle in the ranked pairs algorithm
get_ranked_pairs_sorted: get positively-valued ranked pairs sorted by margin strength for use in the ranked pairs election
get_score_reachable_nodes: compute the score of an alternative as the sum of margins across all reachable nodes in the graph
